shell.title: SCUTOONS Admin
shell.no_access_text: The admin is for SCUTOONS admins. Your account ({email}) doesn't have the admin role.

login.network_error: Can't reach the SCUTOONS server. Try again later.
login.login_failed: That did not work. Check the code and try again.
login.login_intro: Sign in with your email. We send you a one-time code, no password.
login.code_sent: We sent a code to {email}. Enter it here or tap the link in the mail.
login.no_account_hint: The admin is for existing accounts with the admin role.

nav.generate_hint: One signed code with QR and certificate
nav.batches_hint: A whole edition: QR, certificates, ZIP
nav.content_hint: Toons and chapters in the store

palette.label: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Type a section, a code or an email …
palette.keys: ↑↓ move · Enter open · Esc close · Ctrl K or / anywhere

table.select_all: Select all rows on this page

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.chart_scans_hint: Unlock = a device opened the reader with a code.
dashboard.chart_claims_hint: Claim = a code bound to an account.
dashboard.editions_hint: Claimed of all codes (all time); scans and claims in the period.

codes.title: Codes
codes.revoke_confirm: Revoke {code}? It will unlock nothing any more.
codes.reason_hint: Optional, kept with the code (max. 255 characters).
codes.section_facts_hint: What the code is and where it leads.
codes.section_status_hint: A revoked code unlocks nothing and cannot be claimed.
codes.section_activity_hint: Every event of this code, newest first. No emails, devices shortened.
codes.section_certificate_hint: Rebuilt from the stored signature: the same data as when it was signed.
codes.section_raw_hint: The API answer as it is.
codes.no_signature: No signature stored for this code: only the QR SVG can be made.

generate.title: Generate a code
generate.meta: One code, signed with ML-DSA-65; QR SVG and signature are archived on the server.
generate.redirect_hint: Where the reader lands after the QR landing page.
generate.template_coa: Printed on the certificate of authenticity and signed with the code.
generate.template_print: Printed on the access certificate and signed with the code.
generate.sign_failed: Signing failed, the code has no signature: {error}
generate.archive_failed: Could not archive {file} on the server.
generate.how_hint: Same steps as the old generate page.
generate.how_1: The server stores a new 8-character code.
generate.how_2: This browser signs all fields with the server key; the signature is stored with the code.
generate.how_3: Download the QR SVG, the certificate PDF and the signature file.

batches.title: Batches
batches.meta: A batch signs and registers every code of an edition, with QR SVG and certificate.
batches.complete_warning: A complete batch of this edition exists ({done} codes, {date}). Add a new edition to editions.json to make more, or create one anyway.
batches.leave_confirm: The batch is running. Stop it and leave? It can be resumed later.
batches.manifest_hint: Stored on the server after every code (resumable).

users.title: Users & roles
users.section_account_hint: How the account came in and what it has.
users.section_roles_hint: Changes apply right away; the role is checked on every request.
users.revoke_own_admin: Remove your own admin role? You lose access to this app.
users.section_characters_hint: Characters this account may wear as reader avatar. Defaults (every member) come from the setting AVATAR_DEFAULT_UNLOCKS and cannot be revoked here.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.meta: Read-only: the server config (items.json, editions.json, toons.json, permissions.json).
catalog.name: Name
catalog.types_hint: What a code of each type may do.

content.title: Content
content.meta: Read-only: every file in the content store. Editing happens in the creator.
content.empty: Nothing stored for this toon yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.meta: Runtime settings of the API. They apply to the next request, no deploy needed.
settings.section_limits_hint: Per client IP and hour. Every attempt counts. 0 = no limit.
settings.scan_limit_per_hour_hint: Scans per hour from one network (the QR landing page). Events share one IP (one Wi-Fi) – keep this high. 0 = no limit.
settings.lookup_limit_per_hour_hint: Codes checked per hour from one IP in the viewer or via the API (/code/, /access/). Low against guessing codes. 0 = no limit.
